root_cause_label: Agent claimed completion while less pager was still open in tmux pane, leaving an interactive process active
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly fixed the bug via sed but then left a less pager running in the bottom-left tmux pane without quitting it before signaling task completion, causing the evaluator's verification to fail.
t_err_evidence: f. Ctrl-b i.strip() Escape :wq — bad vim keystrokes fail to insert strip() before split
t_commit_evidence: Step 33: agent runs echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT claiming the task is done, while the less pager is still active in pane 0.1 — at this point there are no further actions and failure is locked in.
t_surface_evidence: 15:        parts = line.split(',') — grep shows strip() was never added by vim
trigger_explanation: The agent committed to task completion (step 33) without first quitting the less pager it had just opened (step 32) in the bottom-left tmux pane. This is premature_action because the agent acted on the implicit assumption that viewing the file was sufficient and moved to completion before verifying the terminal state was clean.
